annotations.title: Cost of buying or selling a property in Bulgaria

description: What a property purchase or sale in Bulgaria costs on top of the price: notary fee, registration, the municipality's local acquisition tax, broker commission, certificates, the seller's income tax, and — with a mortgage — the bank's fees, the loan and the monthly payment. For an apartment with a place and an area it adds the likely rent, yield and payback. Use for „колко струва покупката/продажбата", „такси при покупка на имот", „нотариални такси", „местен данък", „колко пари ми трябват за апартамент за 120 000 евро". Amounts in euros.

areaSqm.description: Floor area in m²; with an apartment and a location it adds rent and yield.

broker.description: false when no broker is involved (no commission). Default true.

downPaymentPercent.description: Own funds as a percent of the price; default 20, banks lend at most 85%.

inherited.description: true when the seller inherited the property (no income tax).

interestRatePercent.description: Annual interest rate; default is Realistimo's current average rate.

language.description: Language of the answer's labels and of the realistimo.com link: bg, en, tr, de, ru, ro, el or uk. Default bg.

location.description: Where the property is; sets the municipality's local tax rate. Without it the legal maximum of 3% is used.

mortgage.description: true when the buyer takes a mortgage (ипотечен кредит).

propertyKind.description: Default apartment. commercial = shop, office or other business property.

purchasePrice.description: What the seller paid for the property, in euros — the base of a taxable gain.

role.description: Whose costs: buyer (default), seller, or both sides.

saleIncomeTax.description: For a seller: exempt (default, ЗДДФЛ чл. 13) or taxable. A taxable sale needs purchasePrice.

taxAssessment.description: The данъчна оценка in euros, if known; fees are charged on the higher of it and the price.

name: realistimo_deal_cost

cashNeededEur.description: Price (or down payment with a loan) plus the buyer's fees.

indicative.description: A typical market fee rather than an amount set by law.

localTaxRateListed.description: false when the 3% legal maximum stood in for an unknown municipal rate.

notes.description: How to read the figures; repeat the relevant ones to the user.

url.description: The realistimo.com page this answer comes from.

title: Cost of buying or selling a property in Bulgaria
